rows.high: New subjects usually click for me faster than they do for the people around me
rows.low: New subjects usually take me longer to click than the people around me

rows.high: I can usually learn something new from one good explanation
rows.low: I usually need an explanation several times before I really get it

rows.high: I take in new information easily, whether I read it or hear it
rows.low: I find it hard to take in new information in one go

rows.high: I can keep several new facts in mind at once while I read or listen
rows.low: When several new facts come at once, some of them slip away from me

rows.high: I can usually see the rule or pattern behind a problem
rows.low: The rule or pattern behind a problem is usually hard for me to see

rows.high: I can follow an argument with several steps without losing the thread
rows.low: I lose the thread when an argument has several steps

rows.high: I keep a steady working pace and settle into study quickly
rows.low: My pace is uneven and it takes me a while to settle into study

rows.high: I can switch back into my work easily after an interruption
rows.low: After an interruption it is hard to get back into my work

rows.high: I need my learning to be varied, lively and clearly useful to stay with it
rows.low: I am fine with plain, steady material even when it is not varied or lively

rows.high: Stories, humour and challenges make a big difference to how much I take in
rows.low: Stories, humour and challenges make little difference to how much I take in

rows.high: What I learn stays with me for a long time
rows.low: What I learn fades quickly unless I go back over it

rows.high: I can usually recall things from memory without any prompt
rows.low: I usually need a prompt or a choice of answers to remember things

rows.high: When I get something wrong I recover quickly and try again
rows.low: When I get something wrong it knocks me and I find it hard to try again

rows.high: I stay calm with hard problems and work through them before asking for help
rows.low: Hard problems frustrate me and I want help straight away

rows.high: I check my own understanding and change how I study when it is not working
rows.low: I rarely check my own understanding or change how I study

rows.high: I plan my study and keep to the plan
rows.low: I rarely plan my study and mostly go as I feel

rows.high: I like clear steps, worked examples and detailed feedback
rows.low: I like to work things out from the problem with little guidance

rows.high: I learn best when each idea is shown more than one way, with every step written out
rows.low: One compact explanation is enough for me; I do not need every step shown

rows.high: I study because I want to understand, even when no one is checking
rows.low: I mostly study because of marks, rewards or other people's expectations

rows.high: I keep going with a subject even when it is dull or hard
rows.low: I lose interest in a subject once it is dull or hard

rows.high: I often use ideas from one subject in another, or in daily life
rows.low: I usually keep what I learn in one subject separate from the others

rows.high: I like to understand the big idea and then apply it to new cases
rows.low: I like to learn one case at a time and stay with the cases I was shown
